verdict.rationale: Filing deadlines and late-payment fee schedules are a fair question for an IP office, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack publishes no exact deadline dates and no penalty, late-fee or interest figures. It only mentions pages on paying maintenance fees and reinstating abandoned applications (cipo-docs-14) and a forecasted examination wait time, which is not a filing deadline.

support.subject: As a founder, the filing deadlines and the penalty and interest schedule for missing them are published with exact figures
